summary_en: TX1 Corporation, a subsidiary of Technopro Holdings, acquired 5,179,837 Project Holdings shares (90.98% voting stake) and initiated a share acquisition demand under the Companies Act to acquire all remaining shares and warrants from other shareholders, resulting in complete privatization and delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market on December 11, 2026.
title_en: Announcement Regarding the Decision to Make a Share Acquisition Demand by TX1 Corporation for Our Shares and Other Securities, Approval of the Share Acquisition Demand, and Delisting of Our Shares
translation_en_brief:
TX1 Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Technopro Holdings, commenced a tender offer for all shares and warrants of Project Holdings on September 29, 2026. Following the settlement of the tender offer on November 18, 2026, TX1 acquired 5,179,837 shares, representing 90.98% of voting rights, and thereby attained the status of a special controlling shareholder under the Companies Act of Japan.

On November 19, 2026, TX1 formally notified the company of its intention to exercise the statutory share acquisition demand under Article 179 of the Companies Act. This mechanism allows a shareholder holding more than 90% of voting rights to compulsorily acquire all remaining shares and eligible warrants from other shareholders at a price determined through the prior tender offer process. The company's board of directors approved the acquisition demand on the same date.

As a result of the approval, Project Holdings shares became subject to delisting criteria of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The shares were designated as securities in liquidation settlement effective November 19, 2026, with delisting scheduled for December 11, 2026. Following delisting, trading of Project Holdings shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market will cease.
